name: Operations
description: Operations records in a product's own database through the SQL storage adapter: support requests with a per-request anonymous id, a live stream, mail and bell outboxes, pictures, deletions and an export; a log table with search; an events table with daily totals over the product's figures; and the jobs that keep them, under a table prefix of its own. Error capture, the health checks, box samples and outages stay typed stubs until their release.

extensions.description: Support requests, a log table with search, events with daily totals and the product's metrics over its storage adapter; error capture and health checks are stubs until the next minor release

features: One package over the storage adapter the product passes: seventeen tables under a table prefix of the product's own, with their migrations on PostgreSQL and SQLite
Logs: the lines the product already writes, checked against the keys it declares, kept 14 days and searched by kind, path, status, process and time

Events: counts by kind and plan with the time cut to the hour, kept 90 days, and daily totals of the product's figures by day and by plan, kept two years, with a funnel, retention by sign-up cohort and revenue against cost
Lifecycle events: sixteen kinds a product writes through an outbox inside its own billing transaction, delivered once, with twenty figures and their splits over them
The Analytics views (Figures, Funnel and retention, Money) as React components a product renders behind its own staff check, with English words it may replace
A field rule every line and event is checked against: a closed list of keys the product declares, with refusals counted and never stored
Shared jobs under try-locks: the nightly totals at 00:20 UTC and an hourly sweep that resolves and closes requests by their silence and runs every retention

The shared jobs on the scheduler of record: given the triggers package's scheduler, the sweep, the totals and a minute drain of the mail, bell, Discord and lifecycle outboxes run as its registered jobs, a catch-up of the totals filling the days it missed, and each job's beat is written from its settled runs

Support requests: a thread a person opens from the app and staff work from the admin, each request under an anonymous id of its own, with a live stream, mail to a person who has not read a reply, the product's bell, pictures decoded and written again as WebP with no metadata, links to token paths cut before they are stored, deletion of one request or a whole account, and an export as a zip
Job beats: each shared job and each job of the product's own writes its last run's time and outcome, and health.status() reads them all

A staff jobs page's two halves: ./http's jobs handlers (the list with its counts, a job's page and its full lists, pause, resume and a hand run) over the scheduler of record, under the product's own staff check and error shape, and ./react's useJobs and useJob, which read every 30 seconds while the page is visible and replace a job only from a command's answer

A Discord outbox for staff alerts: one row a fact under its key, delivered through the product's hook with retries, given up after 24 hours into one team mail, and a post carrying an id or an address refused
Error capture and health checks: their tables and types ship now, and their functions throw not_built until the next minor release
An adoption guide in the README for the next product
